name: Request a moving quote
definition: Enable a prospective customer or authorized caller to submit sufficient moving details for a provider to begin the quote process.
capabilityPurpose: Enable a move to be presented to a provider for quote consideration.
meaningfulOutcome: A quote request is accepted for processing, rejected with an intelligible reason, or identified as requiring more information.

interactionContracts.name: Create draft quote request
interactionContracts.currentState: No draft request exists for this interaction
interactionContracts.transition: No request to draft quote request

interactionContracts.name: Validate quote request
interactionContracts.actor: Prospective customer, authorized agent, or system

policiesInvariants.text: A request requires sufficient contact and move details.

interactionContracts.transition: Draft request remains draft with validation result
interactionContracts.result: Valid, missing information, or unsupported move

policiesInvariants.text: The request must satisfy applicable validation rules.

rulesInvariants.text: A submission requires sufficient information to identify the requester and proposed move.

recommendedDefaults.text: Preserve the draft when validation finds missing information.

realizations.name: Illustrative provider realization
realizations.rationaleIntent: A provider may implement this to obtain qualified leads; this is not part of the reusable capability purpose.

implementationRequirements.text: The provider must validate the service area before accepting a submission.

operationalConstraints.text: The provider may serve only configured geographic areas.

sharedElements.notes: Illustrative reuse declaration; actual approval must be evidenced.

agenticMappings.notes: Illustrative tool mapping for Submit quote request.

provenance.text: This instance is illustrative and not a specification for a particular provider.

relatedMLEsByDimension.ref: Serviceable-route rejection rule (a provider may reject a route it does not serve)
Draft to validate to submit flow; preserve-draft-on-missing-information default

relatedMLEsByDimension.notes: Already declared in agenticMappings; referenced here rather than restated.

relatedMLEsByDimension.ref: A submission is never accepted without sufficient identifying information; an unsupported route is rejected, not silently accepted

communicationMLEs.name: Quote Request Submitted Confirmation
communicationMLEs.purpose: Confirm that the request was received and set an honest expectation for what happens next.
communicationMLEs.audience: The prospective customer or authorized caller who submitted the request
requiredMeaning: No further action is currently required from the requester
There is a next step, even if its exact timing is unknown

terminology.text: Call it a "quote request," not an "application" or "order."

toneStyle.text: Clear, calm, concise -- a routine acknowledgement, not a sales pitch.

rules.text: Must not promise a specific response time unless a realization's operational commitment actually guarantees it.

recommendedDefaults.text: If no guaranteed response time exists, say something like "we'll be in touch soon" rather than inventing a number.

exampleCopy.text: Thanks -- your moving quote request has been received. We'll be in touch soon.
